 Steve Avila and Joe Cardona among Rams' inactives for Week 10 at Cardinals
 Nov 15, 2026 at 11:51 AM Stu Jackson Senior Staff Writer
 Copied! 
 GLENDALE, Ariz. – Rams long snapper Joe Cardona (ankle) and offensive lineman Steve Avila  (hamstring) are inactive for today's game against the Cardinals at State Farm Stadium (1:05 p.m. PT, CBS).
 Also inactive for Los Angeles are quarterback Ty Simpson (emergency third QB), safety Maximus Pulley , outside linebacker Darryl Peterson III , offensive lineman Keagen Trost  and outside linebacker Desjuan Johnson .
 For the Cardinals, offensive lineman Jayden Williams (knee) is inactive after being listed as questionable.
 Below are the inactives for both teams.
